_comment: SOURCE OF TRUTH for the Shop roadmap rendered at /extensions/shop/roadmap (phases 1 to 7). Phase 0, the shared Payments extension, is src/data/payments-roadmap.json. Task status is maintained by `npm run roadmap:shop` (scripts/gen-roadmap.mjs) from the extension source tree.

milestones.title: Phase 1 · The catalogue
milestones.goal: Products that can describe almost anything a small business sells, usable as a catalogue before the cart exists.

tasks.title: Products: physical, digital and services
tasks.detail: A product post type with price, sale price and dates, SKU, weight and size, gallery, short and long description, categories and tags. Digital products carry protected files and download limits.

tasks.title: Options and variants
tasks.detail: Size, colour and any other option, with a price, stock, SKU and image per combination, and swatches in the store.

tasks.title: Stock
tasks.detail: Stock per product or variant, held while a customer pays and released if they leave, low-stock alerts, backorders, and a stock history of every change and why it happened.

tasks.title: Extra product fields from Custom Fields
tasks.detail: Any Custom Fields group can attach to products (ingredients, materials, specifications) and show up in the product elements.

tasks.title: Import / Export
tasks.detail: One Import / Export screen: a spreadsheet (CSV) of products and variants for people, and a full JSON file with every setting to move a store between sites. What it exports imports back unchanged.

tasks.title: Catalog mode
tasks.detail: A shop that shows products without selling them: prices shown or hidden, and an enquiry or request-a-quote button that sends a form to the CRM in place of add to cart. No cart, no checkout and no payment code is loaded. Turning selling on later keeps every product as it is.

milestones.title: Phase 2 · Cart and checkout
milestones.goal: A customer can buy and pay, as a guest or with an account.

tasks.title: The cart
tasks.detail: A cart for guests and logged-in customers that survives a login, stores no prices (it is priced again on every read), corrects itself when stock runs out, and takes the shared discount codes.

tasks.title: One-page checkout
tasks.detail: Address, delivery, payment and a summary on one page, checked and priced again on the server, paid through the shared Payments core (hosted pages, bank transfer, free orders). Guest checkout or an account made at checkout, an order page for the buyer, and a "Start selling online" switch that makes the pages.

tasks.title: Delivery
tasks.detail: Shipping zones by country and postcode, flat, weight-based and free-over rates, local pickup, and a hook for carrier rates later.

tasks.title: Order emails
tasks.detail: How to pay, receipt, on its way (with tracking), cancelled and refund emails to the buyer, and a new-order alert to the shop, sent through WordPress mail (Mailer). Designing them in the CRM email builder comes later.

milestones.title: Phase 3 · Running the orders
milestones.goal: Everything after the payment, for the owner and for the customer.

tasks.title: A store admin made for owners
tasks.detail: One clean store screen inside wp-admin: Home (today's sales and what needs doing), Orders, Products, Customers, Discounts, Gift cards, Abandoned carts, Reviews, Reports and Settings, with counts on what needs attention and links across to the CRM and email. No digging through WordPress post lists to run the shop.

tasks.title: Orders and their statuses
tasks.detail: Orders in their own tables (not posts) with pending, waiting for payment, paid, packed, shipped, completed, cancelled and refunded, a To do list, a timeline of every change and email, notes, search and status tabs.

tasks.title: Refunds, tracking and packing slips
tasks.detail: Full or part refunds sent back through the gateway, stock put back, tracking numbers in the shipped email, and printable invoices and packing slips.

tasks.title: My orders in the member area
tasks.detail: Order history, downloads, addresses, reorder and invoices, shown as tabs in the member area Membership already builds, so a site has one account page for everything.

tasks.title: REST API and command line
tasks.detail: Products, orders, customers and stock over REST and WP-CLI, for apps, headless front ends and scripts.

milestones.title: Phase 4 · Designed in the page builder
milestones.goal: Every store page is a normal Unyson+ page: no template files to edit.

tasks.title: Store elements
tasks.detail: Product grid and carousel, single product parts (gallery, price, options, add to cart), categories, product search and filters, cart icon and mini-cart, cart and checkout, styled with Theme Settings presets.

tasks.title: Theme Builder templates and starter pages
tasks.detail: Product, category and search templates in the Theme Builder, and ready-made store pages in the Template Library, so a new store looks finished on the first day.

tasks.title: Blocks and headless
tasks.detail: The same store elements as blocks for block themes, and the REST API documented for headless front ends.

milestones.title: Phase 5 · Connected to every Unyson+ extension
milestones.goal: The reason to build a native store: one customer, one checkout and one record across the whole site.

tasks.title: CRM: every customer is a contact
tasks.detail: Customers become CRM contacts, their orders and total spend fill the CRM's Purchases panel (the purchase summaries the CRM already offers to any store), and buying, refunds and abandoned carts become events for segments, scoring and automations.

tasks.title: Membership: products that grant plans, prices for members
tasks.detail: A product can grant a plan or a course, members can get their own prices or discounts, and products can be for members only, all on Membership's access engine.

tasks.title: Bookings and Forms in the same cart
tasks.detail: A booking deposit or a room night can go in the cart with the products, and a form can add a configured product to the cart.

tasks.title: SEO and Visitor Insights
tasks.detail: Product structured data, product sitemaps and a product feed for shopping listings from the SEO extension. In Visitor Insights: product views, the cart-to-order funnel, and revenue by traffic source, without cookies.

tasks.title: POS Sync store driver
tasks.detail: Shop added as a store in POS Sync, next to the existing store drivers, so till sales and stock stay in step with the online store.

tasks.title: AI Assistant, Chat and the AI Dev Kit
tasks.detail: AI abilities to add products, change prices and stock, look up orders and build store pages. Chat can answer “where is my order” for a logged-in customer. The AI Dev Kit gets a store guide, so a developer can ask Claude to add a feature to the shop and have it built the Unyson+ way.

milestones.title: Phase 6 · Selling more
milestones.goal: The extras that usually need a plugin each.

tasks.title: Abandoned cart recovery
tasks.detail: Shoppers who gave their email at checkout but did not pay, listed with their cart, value and status (open, emailed, recovered, lost), the amount won back and the recovery rate. A ready-made CRM automation sends the first reminder an hour later and a discount nudge a day later, and any reminder can also be sent by hand.

tasks.title: Subscribe and save
tasks.detail: Repeat deliveries of physical products on the shared recurring payments, with skip, pause and cancel in the member area.

tasks.title: Bundles, upsells and gift cards
tasks.detail: Product bundles, upsell and cross-sell picks, order bumps at checkout, and gift cards built on Membership's gifts.

tasks.title: Reviews, wishlist and back-in-stock
tasks.detail: Verified-buyer reviews with stars in the product schema, a wishlist, compare, and back-in-stock emails through the CRM.

milestones.title: Phase 7 · Reports, privacy and moving in
milestones.goal: Run the store with confidence, and move an existing one across.

tasks.title: Reports
tasks.detail: Sales, best sellers, stock value, tax and refunds by day, month or year, with CSV export.

tasks.title: Privacy and security
tasks.detail: Customer data in WordPress's personal data export and erase tools (orders kept as tax records require), and checkout protected against card testing and bots.

tasks.title: Move a WooCommerce store across
tasks.detail: Import products, variants, customers, orders and coupons from WooCommerce into Shop, with a dry run first. The WooCommerce extension stays for sites that keep running WooCommerce.
